title: Product capability
description: One capability of a product, or a category that groups capabilities, at <venture>/product/capabilities/<id>.json (EE-224). Capabilities form a tree under the products function: a category's parent is another category or null (it sits directly under the products function), and a capability always has a category as its parent. Each names the agent role that owns it, the one that keeps its words and its site or docs containers current. A capability is live, building or retired, and nothing under a retired category is live or building (node packages/naive/src/checks/check-ventures.ts). A feature report (naive features, packages/naive/src/engine/feature-report.ts, EE-228) reads it with the records that name it.

name.description: The capability as a customer would name it, for example Time travel

product.description: The product it belongs to: a product card's id in product/ or products/

kind.description: A category groups capabilities and other categories; a capability is one thing the product does

parent.description: The category it sits under, or null for a category directly under the products function

owner.description: The agent role that owns it: <capability>-agent for a capability, the category agent for a category. A container in a site's containers.json names the same role as its owner

summary.description: What it does, in one or two plain sentences

goals.description: The goals it serves, each a goal id in foundation/goals or goal/measure for one measure of it (EE-228). The feature report reads each goal's status from its record

requirements.description: The requirements it meets, each a requirement id in foundation/requirements (EE-228)

rice.description: A person's RICE inputs for it (Intercom's method): the score is reach times impact times confidence over effort, computed by the feature report and never stored (EE-228). Naive ships no value: each is the venture's own estimate

reach.description: How many people or events it reaches in one period

reach_unit.description: What reach counts, for example customers per quarter

impact.description: Intercom's scale: 3 massive, 2 high, 1 medium, 0.5 low, 0.25 minimal

confidence.description: How sure the estimates are, as a share: 1 is 100%

effort.description: Work to build it, in person-months

set_by.description: The person who set these inputs
